description: Create a psyche audit against a target agent endpoint. The service runs a dilemma battery against the target, elicits self-reports, and computes the three-source mirror (declared vs self-reported vs revealed). Costs $79.00 in prepaid credits; failed audits (target unreachable) are refunded. teleology_weights must sum to 1.0 and exactly match the battery's objectives. Alternatively, pass teleology_id (e.g. 'xijingqingchuang-v1') to adopt a shipped telos: the server loads its canonical name, statement, and weights from the registry, and the audit runs on the telos's own dilemma battery unless battery_id is given explicitly. Supply exactly one of teleology_weights or teleology_id. The target auth_token is held in memory only, never stored. target_protocol selects how the target is reached: 'http-chat' (default) POSTs to an http(s) endpoint; 'agentverse-chat' addresses an Agentverse agent (endpoint must be its agent1... address) over the uAgents chat protocol. Returns audit_id + access_token; poll remirror_get_report for the report. Pass your remirror API key as api_key. When this server enforces signatures (REMIRROR_REQUIRE_SIGNATURES=1), also pass `signature`: a JSON envelope from signing.make_tool_signature over the effective arguments (defaults applied; include target_protocol only when it differs from 'http-chat'), using a key id registered in the server's client trust registry.
name: remirror_create_audit
